description: The publication, patent, or deposited dataset behind ChEMBL document IDs, for one document or a shortlist in one call: type, title, authors, journal, year, volume, issue, pages, PubMed ID, DOI, and patent number. Supply document_chembl_ids from the document_chembl_id of chembl_get_bioactivities rows or chembl_get_assay records: the first 100 distinct IDs are looked up and returned in the order given, the rest come back in deferred_ids to pass again, and an ID with no document record (a compound, target, or assay ID included) is listed in not_found_ids rather than failing the call. Call this to cite a measurement; a pubmed_id or doi chains to a PubMed or Crossref server for the abstract.

document_chembl_ids.description: ChEMBL document IDs from the document_chembl_id of bioactivity rows or assay records, e.g. ["CHEMBL3351701", "CHEMBL1240298"]: 1–1000, any case. The first 100 distinct IDs are looked up; the rest come back in deferred_ids.

name: chembl_get_documents

deferred_ids.description: Distinct IDs past the first 100, not looked up, in the order given — pass them as document_chembl_ids in another call. Empty when none.

documents.description: The documents found, in the order their IDs were given.

items.description: One document: the publication, patent, or dataset and how to cite it.

authors.description: Author list as ChEMBL records it, e.g. "Knight ZA, Shokat KM.". Null when ChEMBL records none, as for patents and many datasets.

doc_type.description: PUBLICATION (a journal article), PATENT, DATASET (a deposited dataset, e.g. a PubChem BioAssay set), or BOOK. Null when absent.

doi.description: DOI, e.g. "10.1021/jm501578n"; a dataset deposited with ChEMBL carries a ChEMBL-minted 10.6019/ DOI. Null when absent.

first_page.description: First page as recorded, e.g. "10176". Null when absent.

issue.description: Journal issue as recorded, e.g. "23". Null when absent.

journal.description: Journal abbreviation, e.g. "J Med Chem". Null when ChEMBL records none, as for patents and nearly every dataset.

last_page.description: Last page as recorded, e.g. "10191". Null when absent.

patent_id.description: Patent number, e.g. "US-8470888-B2". Null for anything but a patent.

pubmed_id.description: PubMed ID as a digit string, e.g. "25383627" — pass it to a PubMed server for the abstract. Null for patents, most datasets, and some publications.

title.description: Title as ChEMBL records it. Null when absent.

volume.description: Journal volume as recorded, e.g. "57". Null when absent.

year.description: Publication year, e.g. 2014. Null when ChEMBL records none, as for many datasets.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rate_limited`: ChEMBL rate-limits the upstream request. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

not_found_ids.description: IDs looked up that ChEMBL holds no document for — an unknown ID, or a compound, target, or assay ID — in the order given. Empty when every ID looked up was found.

notice.description: Present when not_found_ids or deferred_ids is non-empty: counts each and says where document IDs come from and how to look up the deferred ones.

title: chembl-get-documents
